title: Adi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: The Arukh, under Nemas, cites Megillah 12b: “Mordechai was crowned with nimus, like Adi”—that is, like a certain man named Adi, well known in his generation and careful in observing the commandments. Rashi there does not include ke-Adi in his text.

notes.text: The Arukh compares Mordechai with a man named Adi; Hyman reports that Rashi lacks ke-Adi. No new identification of Adi is made.
The Arukh’s explanation links the phrase to observance of the Torah. The consulted Bavli omits ke-Adi, and Rashi explains nimus in terms of names.
